name: WUPHF by Nex.ai
description: A collaborative office of AI employees who build and maintain their own knowledge base to never lose context for tasks. Slack-style interface for AI agents with shared wiki. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw agents and local LLMs.
community_quotes: Slack for AI employees with a shared brain

name: Mistral Medium 3.5
description: A 128B dense model for coding, reasoning, and long tasks. Mistral's first merged flagship model with configurable reasoning effort, 256k context window, and 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified. Self-hostable on 4 GPUs with open weights under modified MIT license.

name: Tabstack
description: Extract web data and automate browsers without requiring scrapers. API for browser automation with intelligence built-in. Pass a URL and schema, get back structured JSON. Built at Mozilla with five endpoints for extraction, generation, research, and automation.
community_quotes: Schema-as-contract model is the right call

name: Mintlify Editor
description: AI-native collaborative editor for documentation with GitHub integration. Git-synced, WYSIWYG, live-collaborative editor built for cross-functional collaboration. Allows engineers, marketers, and AI agents to contribute to docs together.
community_quotes: The ability to publish customer facing docs is just amazing

name: Rova AI
description: Autonomous, goal-driven testing for web and mobile apps. AI agent for automated QA testing that explores apps, validates workflows, adapts to UI changes, and generates reports without writing test scripts.

name: Symphony
description: An open-source specification for Codex orchestration. Provides standards and protocols for coordinating multiple AI coding agents and managing their interactions.

name: Kimi K2.6
description: Open-source state-of-the-art model for long-horizon coding and agent swarms. Achieves SOTA performance on complex coding tasks requiring multiple steps and parallel agent coordination.

name: Cosine Swarm
description: Parallel AI agents for long-horizon, complex software tasks. A coordinated team of specialized agents for research, implementation, and QA that works across CLI, cloud, and desktop to complete tasks end-to-end without human supervision.
community_quotes: An AI coworker that actually does the work

name: Chronicle
description: Build Codex memories from recent screen context, providing persistent memory for AI coding agents derived from screen activity. Helps agents maintain context across coding sessions.

name: Spectrum
description: Open-source tool for bringing AI agents to all the interfaces people already use. Integrates AI agents into existing messaging platforms and communication tools.

name: X Island
description: Dynamic Island for AI Coding Agents - provides a compact UI for monitoring AI coding agent activity. Shows agent status and progress in a minimal interface.

name: Blueprint
description: One-shot bigger coding tasks - an AI tool that handles larger coding tasks in a single operation. Designed for complex coding challenges that require substantial work.

name: Basedash Dashboard Agent
description: Builds entire dashboards from a single prompt. AI agent for automated dashboard and analytics creation that transforms natural language descriptions into complete data visualizations.
